{{Otheruses|Star Forge}}
At some point tens of [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] after the collapse of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], a '''Star Forge''' [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]] was undergoing construction in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makatak]]. It was a scaled-down version of the Infinite Empire's original [[Star Forge]] [[Space station/Legends|station]],<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> which was situated in the [[Lehon system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
